books.author: aldo-leopold
books.theme_zh: 把土地当成我们所属的共同体，而不是据为己有的商品
books.theme_en: Treat the land as a community to which we belong, not a commodity we own

prose.description_zh: 美国生态学家、奥尔多·利奥波德（Aldo Leopold, 1887–1948）的随笔与哲学论文集，1949 年由牛津大学出版社在其去世一年后首次出版，由其子 Luna Leopold 编辑整理。全书分三部分：第一部分以四季为序记录作者在威斯康星河畔沙乡农场恢复生态平衡的亲身观察——融雪、橡树年轮、大雁迁徙、猎狼后鹿群啃尽灌丛的「鹿群悖论」；第二部分汇集四十年间游历威斯康星、衣阿华、亚利桑那、索诺拉、俄勒冈、曼尼托巴等地写下的随感；第三部分转入哲学层面，讨论野生动物保护背后的伦理问题，并以著名篇章「土地伦理」（The Land Ethic）收束：「当一个事物倾向于保持生物群落的完整、稳定和美丽时，它就是正确的；当它倾向于相反方向时，它就是错误的。」利奥波德据此主张把人类从土地共同体的征服者改造成普通成员，保护被重新定义为「人与土地之间的和谐状态」。该书出版时几乎未引起注意，1970 年代环保运动中兴起的平装版意外成为畅销书，全球销量逾 200 万册、译成至少 14 种语言；中文版正式版本有译林出版社 2019 年版（侯文蕙译）与人民文学出版社 2022 年版（曹明伦译）等。
prose.description_en: A collection of essays and philosophical papers by the American ecologist Aldo Leopold (1887–1948), first published posthumously by Oxford University Press in 1949 and edited by his son Luna Leopold. The book falls into three parts. The first records, in the order of the four seasons, the author's first-hand observations of ecological restoration on his farm in Sand County, Wisconsin—snowmelt, oak tree rings, the migration of geese, and the deer paradox that followed the extermination of wolves. The second gathers informal pieces written over forty years of travel through Wisconsin, Iowa, Arizona, Sonora, Oregon, Manitoba and beyond. The third turns to the philosophy behind wildlife conservation and closes with the celebrated essay The Land Ethic: A thing is right when it tends to preserve the integrity, stability, and beauty of the biotic community; it is wrong when it tends otherwise. Leopold argues for converting human beings from conquerors of the land-community into plain members of it, redefining conservation as a state of harmony between men and land. Little noticed at publication, the paperback became a surprise bestseller with the environmental awakening of the 1970s; it has sold over two million copies and been translated into at least fourteen languages. Formal Chinese editions include the Yilin Press 2019 translation by Hou Wenhui and the People's Literature Publishing House 2022 translation by Cao Minglun.
prose.why_read_zh: 它不是抒情自然文学的终点，而是一次伦理学的边界扩展。反直觉的核心论点是：把土地当资源来管理，无论管理得多好，都仍然预设了人的主权；真正的转折发生在把「正确」的判准从经济利益改写为生物群落的完整、稳定与美丽。可迁移的框架是「征服者立场 / 共同体成员立场」这组对照：任何技术系统只要把自然当作待优化的变量，结论必然与利奥波德相反，用它检查今日的碳核算、生态修复工程与 AI 驱动的环境监测，第一问不是数据够不够细，而是决策者把自己放在了共同体内外哪一侧。它也不是人畜无害的正确话：土地伦理被批评为把生态学事实直接滑入伦理应然，「美丽」这一判准含混难测，荒野保护与本地社区生计的冲突在第三世界语境下尤有争议——这些严肃反对意见恰好构成重读的支点。读完改变的是提问方式：从如何更有效地利用自然，变成人类在什么程度上可以自称局外。经典性证据：① 英文维基百科有独立书籍条目 A Sand County Almanac，记录 1949 年 Oxford University Press 首版、作者去世后由 Luna Leopold 编辑整理、土地伦理的核心引文、1990 年美国自然研究学会民意调查并列「20 世纪最受尊崇的两部环境著作」（与 Rachel Carson《寂静的春天》并列）、销量逾 200 万册与至少 14 种语言译本，非仅作者页提及；② 权威书评媒体：1949 年 The New York Times Book Review 即以 a trenchant book, full of vigor and bite 评之（该评语为 OUP 官方版本介绍与维基条目同时转引）；③ 出版社背书：Oxford University Press 官网博客 2024 年 4 月 22 日刊发 A Sand County Almanac at 75: the evolution of the land ethic 专题，由 Aldo Leopold Foundation 主席 Buddy Huffaker 与 Leah Bieniak 撰文，回顾土地伦理 75 年的演变；④ 中文读者平台：译林出版社 2019 年版（侯文蕙译）豆瓣 8.4 分、262 人评价，江西人民出版社 2018 年版 8.8 分、179 人评价，微信读书《沙乡年鉴》推荐值 85.8%，人民文学出版社 2022 年版（曹明伦译）正式出版。三项以上分属百科独立条目、权威书评媒体、出版社官网与中文读者平台四个不同来源类型。时间检验：1949 年首版，至 2026-11-12 已满 77 年。HN 提及与百度学术数据本次未作为证据使用。未计入项：Goodreads 精确评分与评价人数本次未获取，不编造。
prose.why_read_en: It is not the terminus of lyrical nature writing but an expansion of the boundary of ethics. The counter-intuitive thesis: managing land as a resource, however well, still presupposes human sovereignty; the real turn happens when the criterion of right is rewritten from economic interest to the integrity, stability, and beauty of the biotic community. The portable frame is the conqueror-versus-member distinction. Any technical system that treats nature as a variable to be optimized lands on the opposite side of Leopold; applied to carbon accounting, restoration projects and AI-driven environmental monitoring, the first question is not whether the data are fine-grained enough but on which side of the community the decision-maker places himself. Nor is it innocuous: the land ethic is faulted for sliding from ecological facts directly to ethical oughts, for the vagueness of beauty as a criterion, and for the collision between wilderness protection and local livelihoods in developing-world contexts—objections that form exactly the fulcrum for rereading. What changes is the question, from how to use nature more efficiently to in what sense humans may claim to stand outside it. Evidence of standing: (1) a standalone English Wikipedia article recording the 1949 Oxford University Press first edition, posthumous editing by Luna Leopold, the defining Land Ethic quotation, the 1990 American Nature Study Society poll naming it (with Rachel Carson's Silent Spring) one of the two most honored environmental works of the 20th century, over two million copies sold and at least fourteen translations; (2) a 1949 New York Times Book Review notice, quoted by both the OUP edition description and the Wikipedia article (a trenchant book, full of vigor and bite); (3) publisher endorsement: Oxford University Press's own blog published A Sand County Almanac at 75: the evolution of the land ethic on 22 April 2024, written by Buddy Huffaker and Leah Bieniak of the Aldo Leopold Foundation; (4) Chinese reader platforms: the 2019 Yilin Press edition (Hou Wenhui) holds 8.4 on Douban from 262 ratings, the 2018 Jiangxi People's Press edition 8.8 from 179 ratings, the WeRead recommendation value stands at 85.8%, and a 2022 People's Literature Publishing House translation by Cao Minglun is formally published. These span at least four distinct source types: encyclopedia entry, authoritative review media, publisher site and Chinese reader platform. Time test: first published 1949, 77 years ago as of 2026-11-12. Goodreads exact figures were not obtained this run and are not fabricated. Not counted: Hacker News mention counts and Baidu Scholar citation figures, per the evidence rules.
core_ideas_zh: 土地伦理的判准转换：一个事物正确与否，取决于它是否倾向于保持生物群落的完整、稳定与美丽，而不是取决于它给人类带来多少经济回报。这把伦理学的适用范围从人与人之间扩展到人与整个共同体。
征服者与成员的身份区分：人类迄今把土地当作主权范围内的财产，利奥波德要求把这一身份改写为共同体内的普通成员。保护不再是管理资源，而是维持和谐状态——Conservation is a state of harmony between men and land。
生态素养先于政策：沙乡四季观察、旅鸽灭绝与猎狼后鹿群悖论等案例共同说明，缺乏对土地机制的认知，任何善意政策都可能制造反向破坏；伦理判断必须建立在长期田野观察之上。
立场可被反驳：土地伦理被质疑把生态学描述直接当作伦理规范，「美丽」判准含混，荒野保护与原住民及本地社区的冲突也未被充分处理——这些严肃反对意见使它成为可被检验的立场而非正确废话。
core_ideas_en: The criterion shift of the land ethic: a thing is right when it tends to preserve the integrity, stability, and beauty of the biotic community, not when it maximizes human economic return. This extends ethics from person-to-person relations to the whole community.

The conqueror-versus-member distinction: humanity has treated land as property within its sovereignty; Leopold asks us to rewrite that identity as plain membership. Conservation ceases to be resource management and becomes a state of harmony between men and land.

Ecological literacy precedes policy: the seasonal observations, the passenger-pigeon extinction and the deer paradox after wolf extermination together show that well-meant policies backfire without understanding how land works; ethical judgement rests on long field observation.

The position is open to refutation: critics object that it slides from ecological description straight to ethical norm, that beauty is a vague criterion, and that wilderness protection collides with indigenous and local livelihoods—serious objections that make it a testable stance rather than an innocuous truth.
key_questions_zh: 如果把「正确」定义为维护生物群落的完整、稳定与美丽，那么一座城市扩张、一片农田休耕、一条河流截流，分别应通过什么检验才算正确？
人类究竟在什么意义上可以是土地共同体的成员而不是征服者——这个身份转换在制度、产权与日常生活层面各意味着什么？
key_questions_en: If right is defined as preserving the integrity, stability, and beauty of the biotic community, what test should urban expansion, fallow farmland, or a dammed river each pass to count as right?
In what sense can humans be members of the land community rather than its conquerors, and what would that identity shift mean at the level of institutions, property rights, and everyday life?
prose.who_should_read_zh: 关心环境伦理、生态保护与土地政策的读者；写自然观察、乡村与非虚构作品的人；以及任何想检验「可持续发展」这类口号背后究竟有没有伦理判准的人。不适合寻找行动清单或技术指南的读者——它给出的是立场的转换，不是操作手册；适合愿意在四季观察的慢节奏里跟到一个锋利结论的人。
prose.who_should_read_en: Readers concerned with environmental ethics, conservation and land policy; writers of nature observation, rural non-fiction and essays; and anyone who wants to test whether slogans such as sustainable development rest on an ethical criterion at all. It is not for readers looking for an action checklist or a technical manual—it offers a conversion of stance, not procedures—and suits those willing to follow slow seasonal observation to a sharp conclusion.
prose.reading_note_zh: 建议按全书原序读：先过四季观察部分（第一部分），不要急着跳到土地伦理——第三部分的锋芒完全建立在前期田野细节上，「像山那样思考」与「大雁归来」是理解判准转换的钥匙。读「土地伦理」一节时随身带三个问题：判准是否可操作、成员身份如何落地、反对者会从哪里切入。配合本期另一本《无穷的开始》对读：一本把进步归结为无限的知识创造，一本把进步限定在人类对土地的责任，两者对「人类能动性」的边界给出相反方向的压力。中文版可取译林出版社 2019 年侯文蕙译本（经典译林系列）或人民文学出版社 2022 年曹明伦译本，注意与《沙郡岁月》等旧译书名区分。
prose.reading_note_en: Read in the original order: take the four seasonal observation sections first and resist jumping ahead to The Land Ethic—the sharpness of the third part rests entirely on the field detail accumulated earlier, and passages such as Thinking Like a Mountain and the geese arrival piece are the keys to the criterion shift. While reading The Land Ethic, keep three questions at hand: whether the criterion is operational, how membership would land in practice, and where a critic would enter. It pairs well with this edition's The Beginning of Infinity: one traces progress to unbounded knowledge creation, the other confines progress to human responsibility toward land, and the two press on the boundary of human agency from opposite directions. Chinese readers can use the 2019 Yilin Press translation by Hou Wenhui (Classics of Yilin series) or the 2022 People's Literature Press translation by Cao Minglun; beware of older renderings of the title such as 沙郡岁月.

books.title_zh: 无穷的开始：世界进步的本源
books.title_en: The Beginning of Infinity: Explanations That Transform the World
books.author: david-deutsch
books.theme_zh: 一切进步的根基不是数据或算力，而是能够不断逼近实在的好解释
books.theme_en: The foundation of all progress is not data or computation but good explanations that approximate reality without limit

prose.description_zh: 英国量子物理学家、量子计算奠基人之一戴维·多伊奇（David Deutsch，牛津大学物理学教授、英国皇家学会会员）的跨学科著作，英文原名 The Beginning of Infinity: Explanations That Transform the World，2011 年 3 月由 Allen Lane（英国）/ 7 月 Viking（美国）首版，2012 年 Penguin 平装再版。全书核心主张：宇宙中存在一个客观上无限的过程——好解释的创造，而解释（explanation）而非数据或预测才是知识的根本单位。多伊奇把四个深奥领域串成一条论证线：量子物理学（多世界诠释与可替代性 fungibility）、进化论（基因是承载知识的解释载体）、认识论（波普尔式可证伪性与「好解释」的标准：难改动性 hard-to-vary）、计算理论（图灵机与计算的普遍性，由此推出通用解释力没有内在上限）。由此推出全书最锋利的论断：问题不可避免，但所有问题原则上都可以解决——乐观主义不是愿望而是关于知识创造本性的定理；所有恶与失败都是知识不足的产物。书中专章处理人工智能：他指出图灵测试提出六十年来 AI 进展甚微，通用智能不能由计算能力堆砌得到，创造力（creativity）不可归约为算法，并提出一个判据——向机器人的进化程序输入真正的随机数，观察知识是否自发产生。中文正式版为人民邮电出版社 2014 年 11 月版《无穷的开始：世界进步的本源》，王艳红、张韵译，ISBN 9787115365385，2019 年 3 月出第 2 版。
prose.description_en: A cross-disciplinary work by the British quantum physicist David Deutsch, Professor of Physics at Oxford and a Fellow of the Royal Society, one of the founders of quantum computation. Published in 2011 by Allen Lane in the UK (March) and Viking in the US (July), with a Penguin paperback in 2012. Its central claim: the universe contains an objectively infinite process—the creation of good explanations—and that explanations, not data or predictions, are the fundamental unit of knowledge. Deutsch weaves four deep strands into one argument: quantum physics (the many-worlds interpretation and fungibility), evolution (genes as carriers of knowledge-bearing explanations), epistemology (Popperian falsifiability and the criterion of a good explanation—being hard to vary), and computation (Turing machines and the universality of computation, from which he derives that there is no intrinsic upper bound on explanatory reach). The sharpest conclusion: problems are unavoidable, yet every problem is in principle solvable—optimism is not a wish but a theorem about the nature of knowledge creation, and all evil and failure are products of insufficient knowledge. The book devotes chapters to artificial intelligence: sixty years after the Turing test, Deutsch argues, AI has made little progress; general intelligence cannot be assembled from computational capacity, creativity cannot be reduced to algorithm, and he proposes a test—feed genuine randomness into a robot's evolutionary program and observe whether knowledge arises spontaneously. The formal Chinese edition is 无穷的开始：世界进步的本源, translated by Wang Yanhong and Zhang Yun, published by Posts & Telecom Press in November 2014 (ISBN 9787115365385), with a second edition in March 2019.
prose.why_read_zh: 它提供的是 AI 争论里最稀缺的东西：一个关于「什么才算解释」的严格标准，而不是又一份能力清单。反直觉的核心论点是，通用人工智能的障碍不在算力而在创造力——知识创造不能由任何计算过程穷尽，因为好解释的标志是「难以改动」（hard to vary）：每个细节都承担功能，改一处即崩塌，这正是它与随便一个拟合数据的假故事的区别。可迁移的框架是三层：好解释的标准（难改动性）、乐观主义定理（问题不可避免但原则上皆可解决）、静态社会与动态社会的区分（知识创造机制是否开放）。用它重看今天的 LLM 狂潮，第一个问题就不是参数规模，而是系统产出的东西里有没有难改动结构。立场明确可被反驳：多世界诠释至今是少数派立场；他把文化、道德与美学都纳入解释框架，被 The Independent 批评为在美学与道德哲学上「立足点不太稳固」；David Albert 在 The New York Times 指出它呈现的不是紧密累积的思想体系，而是一场博学而漫谈的对话——这些严肃反对意见使它远不止于畅销科普。读完改变的是提问方式：从这个系统能做什么，变成它的输出里有没有不可压缩的解释结构。经典性证据：① 英文维基百科有独立书籍条目 The Beginning of Infinity，记录 2011 年 Allen Lane/Viking 首版、四条论证主线（多世界诠释、进化、认识论、计算普遍性）、对 Jared Diamond 的批评，以及独立的 Reception 节，非仅作者页提及；② 权威书评媒体长评：The Economist 评其与前作 The Fabric of Reality 同样大胆、结论同样深刻；The New York Times 刊 Columbia 大学哲学教授 David Albert 的书评，称其辉煌且令人振奋（brilliant and exhilarating）同时指出结构上的漫谈性；The Independent 与 Kirkus Reviews 亦有专评；③ 微信读书《无穷的开始》推荐值 81.7%；④ 正式中文版：人民邮电出版社 2014 年 11 月（王艳红、张韵译，科学新经典文丛，ISBN 9787115365385），2019 年 3 月第 2 版，豆瓣中文第 1 版 8.2 分（963 人评价，接近但未达 1000 人门槛，不计入证据）。四项分属百科独立条目、权威书评媒体、中文阅读平台与正式出版记录。补充背景：作者为量子计算奠基人之一、1998 年 Dirac Medal（英国物理学会）得主，2022 年破基础物理学奖得主（作者履历事实，不作为本书获奖计入）。时间检验：2011 年首版，至 2026-11-12 已满 15 年，满足 ≥5 年。本书的 HN 池未覆盖，走独立检索入选。未计入项：英文版豆瓣 7.6 分 / 36 人评价（未达门槛）、Goodreads 精确评分与评价人数本次未获取、Google Scholar 引用数未取得可核验数值，均不编造。
prose.why_read_en: It supplies the scarcest thing in the AI debate: a strict standard for what counts as an explanation, rather than another list of capabilities. The counter-intuitive thesis is that the barrier to artificial general intelligence lies not in compute but in creativity—knowledge creation cannot be exhausted by any computational procedure, because the mark of a good explanation is that it is hard to vary: every detail carries function and the structure collapses if one piece is altered, which is precisely what distinguishes it from a story fitted to data. The portable frame has three layers: the criterion of a good explanation (hard-to-varyness), the optimism theorem (problems are unavoidable yet solvable in principle), and the distinction between static and dynamic societies (whether the mechanism of knowledge creation is open). Re-read against today's LLM boom, the first question is not parameter count but whether the system's outputs contain hard-to-vary structure. The position is explicitly refutable: the many-worlds interpretation remains a minority stance; folding culture, morality and aesthetics into the explanatory framework drew The Independent's criticism that his footing grows less secure when applied to aesthetics and moral philosophy; and David Albert wrote in The New York Times that the book presents not a tight, cumulative system but a broad, erudite, digressive conversation—serious objections that make it far more than a bestseller. What changes is the question, from what can this system do to whether there is incompressible explanatory structure in its outputs. Evidence of standing: (1) a standalone English Wikipedia article recording the 2011 Allen Lane/Viking first editions, the four argumentative strands (many-worlds, evolution, epistemology, universality of computation), the critique of Jared Diamond, and a separate Reception section; (2) authoritative long reviews: The Economist found it as bold as The Fabric of Reality with equally profound conclusions; The New York Times carried David Albert, Professor of Philosophy at Columbia, calling it brilliant and exhilarating while noting its digressive structure; The Independent (Doug Johnstone and Peter Forbes) and Kirkus Reviews also reviewed it; (3) the WeRead recommendation value stands at 81.7%; (4) a formal Chinese translation exists: 无穷的开始：世界进步的本源, Posts & Telecom Press, November 2014, Wang Yanhong and Zhang Yun (Science New Classics series, ISBN 9787115365385), second edition March 2019, with the Douban record for the first Chinese edition at 8.2 from 963 ratings—near but below the 1,000-rating threshold, hence not counted as evidence. These span four distinct source types. Background, not counted as the book's own awards: Deutsch is a founder of quantum computation, winner of the 1998 Dirac Medal (Institute of Physics) and the 2022 Breakthrough Prize in Fundamental Physics. Time test: first published 2011, fifteen years ago as of 2026-11-12. The book is not covered by the Hacker News pool and was selected via independent search. Not counted, not fabricated: Douban English-edition score 7.6 from 36 ratings (below threshold), exact Goodreads figures and Google Scholar citation counts not obtained this run.
core_ideas_zh: 解释优于预测：知识的根本单位不是数据也不是预言，而是好解释；判断标准是难改动性（hard to vary）——每个细节都承担功能、牵一处即全盘崩塌，这才是它区别于事后拟合故事的地方。
计算的普遍性推出解释的无限性：图灵证明通用计算存在，多伊奇由此论证好解释的创造是宇宙里客观上无限的过程，人类知识进步没有内在上限，只有物理定律的边界。
乐观主义是定理不是愿望：所有问题不可避免，但所有问题原则上都可解决；一切恶与失败都是知识不足的产物。这一立场把进步从统计学问题改写为解释学问题。
对 AI 的硬约束：通用智能不等于可计算性的堆砌，创造力不可归约为算法；图灵测试提出六十年后 AI 进展甚微这一事实本身，就是符号主义与连接主义共同绕开的证据。
立场可被反驳：多世界诠释仍是量子力学少数派诠释；把道德与美学纳入解释框架被批评为越界；整体结构被 NYT 批评为漫谈而非累积体系——这些反对意见构成了严肃的重读路径。
core_ideas_en: Explanation over prediction: the fundamental unit of knowledge is not data nor forecast but a good explanation, judged by being hard to vary—every detail carries function and the structure collapses if one piece is altered, which is what separates it from a story fitted after the fact.

Universality of computation entails infinity of explanation: Turing proved universal computation exists, and Deutsch argues that the creation of good explanations is an objectively infinite process in the universe; human knowledge has no intrinsic ceiling, only the boundary of physical law.

Optimism as a theorem, not a wish: problems are unavoidable yet all are in principle solvable, and all evil and failure are products of insufficient knowledge—a move that rewrites progress from a statistical question into an explanatory one.

A hard constraint on AI: general intelligence is not an assembly of computability, and creativity cannot be reduced to algorithm; the meagre progress sixty years after the Turing test is itself evidence of what both symbolic and connectionist schools have skirted.

The position is refutable: the many-worlds interpretation remains a minority reading of quantum mechanics; folding morality and aesthetics into the explanatory framework is faulted as overreach; the NYT found the structure digressive rather than cumulative—objections that constitute a serious path for rereading.
key_questions_zh: 如果好解释的标准是难改动性，那么今天一个大模型产出的「解释」中，有多少细节承担功能、多少只是可被任意替换的拟合？用什么操作检验这两者的区别？
通用智能能否由计算普遍性推出，还是创造力构成计算之外的第四类东西——多伊奇主张后者，这个主张依赖的前提是否成立？
key_questions_en: If the mark of a good explanation is that it is hard to vary, how much of what a large model produces today has functional detail and how much is freely replaceable fitting—and what operational test separates the two?

Can general intelligence be derived from the universality of computation, or does creativity constitute a fourth thing beyond computation? Deutsch argues the latter; do the premises of that argument hold?
prose.who_should_read_zh: 关心 AI 本质争论（而非年度进展播报）的读者；做研究、产品或投资，需要一套判别「真解释」与「故事拟合」的工具的人；以及对量子力学多世界诠释、进化认识论与启蒙运动辩护有兴趣的读者。不适合寻找机器学习操作手册或技术路线的读者——它不讨论任何工程实现，讨论的是智能、解释与进步的可能性条件本身；阅读时需要接受跨学科跳转与长论证链。
prose.who_should_read_en: Readers concerned with the substance of the AI debate rather than the annual progress bulletin; people in research, product or investment who need a tool for separating real explanations from stories fitted to data; and those interested in the many-worlds interpretation of quantum mechanics, evolutionary epistemology and the defence of the Enlightenment. It is not for readers looking for a machine-learning manual or a technology roadmap—it discusses no engineering implementation, only the conditions of possibility for intelligence, explanation and progress—and it asks the reader to tolerate interdisciplinary jumps and long argumentative chains.
prose.reading_note_zh: 建议按论证链读：第 1–2 章的解释标准与第 3 章的思想火花是全书地基，先立住「难改动性」再进入量子与进化部分；第 9 章乐观主义与第 11–12 章文化、静态社会是把前三条线索合拢的地方，不宜跳。读 AI 相关章节时对照本期另一本《沙乡年鉴》：一本把人类能动性推向无穷（好解释的创造没有上限），一本把人类位置限定为土地共同体的成员——两本书对「人的边界」给出相反方向的张力，对读比单读更能暴露各自的预设。中文以人民邮电出版社 2014 年王艳红、张韵译本为准（2019 年第 2 版），注意与作者《真实世界的脉络》（The Fabric of Reality）区分，后者是前作的四条主线综述。
prose.reading_note_en: Follow the argumentative chain: chapters 1–2 on the criterion of explanation and chapter 3 on the sparks of thought form the foundation—fix hard-to-varyness before moving to the quantum and evolution parts; chapter 9 on optimism and chapters 11–12 on culture and static societies close the loop of the first three strands and should not be skipped. While reading the AI chapters, set this edition's A Sand County Almanac alongside it: one pushes human agency toward infinity (the creation of good explanations has no ceiling), the other confines the human position to membership in the land community—the two pull the boundary of the human in opposite directions, and reading them together exposes each book's presuppositions better than reading either alone. The Chinese standard is the 2014 Posts & Telecom Press translation by Wang Yanhong and Zhang Yun (second edition 2019); do not confuse it with the author's The Fabric of Reality, the earlier survey of the four strands.
